name: Air Force 1 '07
description: The 1982 basketball shoe that never left the street: a full-grain leather upper in triple white, a chunky cupsole with Air cushioning in the heel and a perforated toe box. It reads loud and clean at once, the shoe that goes under baggy cargos, wide denim and oversized hoodies. Keep it box-fresh or let it crease; both are part of the point.
details: Full-grain leather upper with stitched overlays
Rubber cupsole with encapsulated Air unit in the heel
Runs about a half size large; consider sizing down
Wipe clean with a damp cloth

name: Pegasus 41
description: Nike's everyday road trainer, with a breathable engineered mesh upper, ReactX foam and Air Zoom units front and back for a springy, protective ride. It handles easy miles, tempo days and the walk to the gym without fuss. White with volt and black accents, it looks the part on a track and does not look out of place after.
details: Engineered mesh upper with padded collar and tongue
ReactX midsole with forefoot and heel Air Zoom units
10 mm heel-to-toe drop; about 280 g (men's EU 42)
True to size for most runners

name: Cortez Leather
description: The slim 1972 runner that became a West Coast street staple, in smooth white leather with a varsity red Swoosh and a blue-striped herringbone sole. It has a low, narrow profile and a slight wedge that sits nicely under flared track pants and low-rise denim. Sporty, a little retro, and easy to wear every day.
details: Foam wedge midsole with herringbone rubber outsole
Slim, narrow last; go half a size up if you have wide feet

name: Samba OG
description: Born as a football trainer for icy pitches, the Samba is all low profile: soft white leather, a suede T-toe overlay, black three stripes and a gum rubber sole. It is the terrace shoe that crossed into everything, from baggy jeans and track tops to cropped trousers. Slim through the toe, so it looks sharp rather than chunky.
details: Leather upper with suede T-toe overlay
Narrow fit; wide feet should size up half a size

name: Gazelle Indoor
description: The indoor training Gazelle in soft blue fusion suede with white stripes and a translucent blue gum sole. It has a slim, low-slung shape and that slightly flattened toe that sits nicely under low-rise jeans, mini skirts and track pants. Playful color, early-2000s attitude, comfortable all day.
details: Suede upper with leather three stripes
Slim fit; true to size for narrow to average feet

name: 990v6 Made in USA
description: The grey-suede running shoe, built in New Balance's New England factories with a pigskin suede and mesh upper and a FuelCell and ENCAP midsole that feels cushioned without being soft. In tonal grey it disappears into a neutral outfit: wide trousers, a navy crewneck, a plain overcoat. Built for long days on your feet, whether that is a run or a commute.
details: FuelCell foam with ENCAP heel support
Made in USA with domestic and imported materials

description: A 1989 basketball shoe brought back from the archive, in white leather with a forest green N and heel tab. It has a low, padded collar and a flat cupsole that make it feel more campus than court. Wear it with chinos and a cable knit, or with a boxy tee and wide cargos.
details: Leather upper with perforated toe box
Runs true to size; roomy toe box

name: XT-6
description: A trail racing shoe from the French Alps, with an anti-debris mesh upper, Quicklace cords and a deep-lugged Contagrip outsole that grips wet rock and gravel. In black and olive night with a phantom-grey midsole, it works on the trail and looks just as right with ripstop pants and a shell in town. Light, technical and stable over rough ground.
details: Anti-debris mesh upper with welded overlays
Quicklace pull-cord lacing with lace pocket
Contagrip rubber outsole with 4 mm lugs
Narrow fit; consider half a size up

name: V-10 Leather
description: A clean leather court shoe with a quiet V on the side, made with chrome-free leather, organic cotton laces and a sole of Amazonian wild rubber and rice waste. Off-white with a pale sable heel, it is the low-key white sneaker for tailored trousers, straight jeans and linen. It softens and creases into your foot over a few weeks.
details: Wild rubber and rice waste outsole
Recycled polyester and organic cotton lining
True to size; slightly snug at first

name: Leather Court Sneaker
description: A plain low-top in soft off-white calf leather with a stitched cupsole and no visible branding at all. The shape is slim and flat, close to a tennis shoe, so it sits neatly under wide wool trousers or cropped denim. Calm, considered and easy to keep looking good.
details: Calf leather upper and leather lining

name: Static Suede Trainer
description: SEOM's slim retro trainer in washed black suede with a cracked-silver side stripe and a thin gum sole, drawn by the founders after the indoor football shoes they wore in Seongsu in the 2000s. It is low, narrow and close to the ground, the opposite of a chunky sneaker. Made to go under oversized tees, nylon cargos and wide denim.
details: Split suede upper with metallic leather stripe
Printed founder graphic on the sockliner
Narrow last; size up half a size for wide feet
imageQuery: black suede slim sneakers silver stripe

name: Signal Metallic Runner
description: A slim, low-slung runner in chrome-silver nylon and mesh with reflective piping and a sculpted white foam sole, modeled on the millennium-era running shoes SEOM's founders grew up wanting. It has real cushioning for a light jog but mostly lives under track pants, baby tees and low-rise denim. Shiny, sporty and a little bit futuristic.
details: Metallic nylon and mesh upper with 3M reflective piping
EVA foam midsole with rubber outsole pods

name: 1460 Smooth Leather Boot
description: The original eight-eye boot from 1960, in stiff black Smooth leather with yellow welt stitching, a heel loop and the bouncing AirWair sole. It takes a few weeks of wear to soften and then moulds to your foot for years. Heavy, dependable and dark, it suits long black coats, ripped denim and everything in between.
details: Air-cushioned PVC sole, oil and fat resistant
Comes in whole sizes; if between sizes, go down

name: Jadon Platform Boot
description: The 1460 silhouette on a chunky platform: black Polished Smooth leather, a side zip, eight eyelets and a deeply cleated sole that adds about 5 cm of height. It is the boot for long black slip dresses, leather trousers and layered mesh, heavy and moody without being hard to walk in. The inside zip makes it easy to get on and off.
details: Air-cushioned PVC sole with deep tread
Whole sizes; if between sizes, go down
imageQuery: black leather platform combat boots woman

name: Alder Moc-Toe Boot
description: A six-inch moc-toe work boot in oil-tanned brown leather on a white wedge crepe sole, hand-stitched at the toe and Goodyear welted so it can be resoled. The leather is stiff for the first couple of weeks, then darkens and creases into something that is entirely yours. Made for selvedge denim, duck canvas and chore coats, and for actual work.
details: Hand-sewn moc toe, Goodyear welt construction
White wedge crepe outsole, fully resoleable
Made in Portland, Oregon; free first resole through our workshop
imageQuery: brown leather moc toe work boots

name: Willamette Hiking Boot
description: A mid-height hiker in waxed brown suede and Burnside's own 12 oz waxed canvas, with a waterproof membrane, speed hooks and a lugged Vibram sole. It is lighter than it looks and handles muddy Cascades trails, then goes straight to the pub with ripstop pants and a fleece. Stitch-down construction means it can be rebuilt rather than thrown out.
details: Waxed suede and 12 oz waxed cotton canvas upper

name: Kessel Lace-Up Boot
description: A heavy ten-eye boot in washed black calf leather that looks already worn in, with brushed silver hooks at the top and a stacked commando sole. It is cut long and slim up the shin so it sits under long draped trousers or over black jeans. Dark, weighty and quiet about it.
details: Washed calf leather with leather lining
Blake-stitched to a lug commando rubber sole, 4.5 cm
Brushed silver eyelets and speed hooks
Made in Portugal for Asche, Berlin
imageQuery: black chunky leather lace up boots

name: Spree Chelsea Boot
description: A pointed Chelsea boot in soft black glove leather with a slim silver harness ring at the ankle and a 6 cm block heel. The elastic gores are black on black, so the whole boot reads as one long dark line under a maxi skirt or cropped leather trousers. Moody, sharp and comfortable enough to stay out in.
details: Glove leather upper with leather lining
6 cm stacked block heel, rubber top lift
Black elastic side gores and pull tab
Made in Portugal for Asche, Berlin

name: X Ultra 4 Mid Gore-Tex
description: A light mid-height hiking boot with a Gore-Tex membrane, an Advanced Chassis for ankle stability on uneven ground, and a grippy All Terrain Contagrip sole. It feels more like a trail runner than a boot from day one, no break-in. Olive, black and a flash of orange, it suits wet weekend hikes and gorpcore city wear alike.
details: Synthetic and textile upper with Gore-Tex membrane
All Terrain Contagrip outsole, 4 mm lugs
True to size with room for hiking socks

name: Kittery Duck Boot
description: The New England slush boot: a hand-poured rubber chain-tread bottom bonded to a tan full-grain leather upper, with brass eyelets and a cream wool-blend lining. It keeps your feet dry from the first snow to the April mud, with chinos, a rugby shirt or a quilted jacket. Built to be passed down with a fresh pair of laces.
details: Full-grain leather upper, rubber shell bottom

name: Arizona Soft Footbed Suede
description: The two-strap slide on a cork-latex footbed with an extra layer of foam, so it is comfortable from the first wear and shapes itself to your foot over a summer. Taupe suede straps with adjustable brass-tone buckles. Throw it on with linen shorts by the water, or with socks and wide trousers in town.
details: Suede upper with adjustable pin buckles
Contoured cork-latex footbed with soft foam layer, suede lined
Regular width; narrow width available on request

name: Boston Suede Clog
description: The closed-toe clog on Birkenstock's cork footbed, in oiled mink-grey suede with a single adjustable strap. It slips on in a second, holds its shape for years, and has become a quiet favorite with wool socks, wide trousers and a plain knit. Comfortable enough to wear all day, at home or out.
details: Regular width; true to Birkenstock sizing

name: Deià Espadrille
description: A classic flat espadrille in sand-washed linen with a hand-stitched jute sole and a thin rubber tread underneath, made by a family workshop in La Rioja. It molds to your foot, goes sockless with linen trousers or a swim short, and gets better looking as the jute frays a little. Breezy, sun-faded and made for long hot days.
details: Hand-stitched natural jute sole with vulcanized rubber tread
Fits snug at first and gives with wear; size down if between sizes
Spot clean only; keep out of standing water

name: Fornalutx Leather Sandal
description: A flat sandal in soft cognac vegetable-tanned leather with woven crossing straps over the toes, a slim ankle strap and a jute-wrapped sole. It looks hand-made because it is, by a small workshop in Inca, Mallorca. Pairs with a white linen dress, a flowy skirt or cropped wide trousers at the beach bar.

name: Alfama Crochet Sandal
description: A flat slide with an open crochet upper hand-worked in cream organic cotton at the Malha Lisboa mill, set on a cork footbed and a stitched leather sole made with a shoemaker in Felgueiras. It has a soft, slightly undone look, like the shawl on your grandmother's chair. Lovely with a broderie dress, a tiered skirt or wide linen trousers.
details: Each pair takes about four hours to crochet; slight variations are normal

name: Adrian Tassel Loafer
description: A tassel loafer with a kiltie fringe in black Smooth leather, set on Dr. Martens' air-cushioned sole with yellow welt stitching. It is the ivy loafer made tougher: right with grey flannels and white socks, just as right with a long black coat and slim black jeans. Expect a short break-in, then years of wear.
details: Smooth leather upper with kiltie fringe and tassels
Whole sizes; if between sizes, go down

name: Wickford Penny Loafer
description: A hand-sewn penny loafer in burnished burgundy calf leather, with a beefroll saddle, a leather sole and a rubber heel. The shape is slim and low, built on a last Cranmore has used since the 1970s. Wear it with grey flannels, chinos and an oxford shirt, or with jeans and a cable knit.
details: Burnished calf leather upper, leather lining

name: Watch Hill Boat Shoe
description: A two-eye boat shoe in oiled tan leather with rawhide 360-degree lacing and a white siped rubber sole that grips a wet deck. Worn sockless, it softens quickly and darkens with salt and sun. Made for summer sailing weekends, chino shorts and a faded oxford shirt.

name: Frogner Mary Jane
description: A round-toe Mary Jane in soft rose-pink patent leather with a thin buckled strap, a small 3 cm heel and a scalloped edge along the throat. It is sweet without being childish, with a gingham dress and white socks, a puff-sleeve blouse and a full skirt, or plain jeans. Made in small runs in Portugal.
details: Patent calf leather upper, leather lining
3 cm stacked heel, leather sole with rubber insert

name: Bygdøy Ballet Flat
description: A soft ballet flat in cream nappa leather with a gathered drawstring bow at the toe and a flexible leather sole that folds in half. It is light and quiet on the foot, as easy with a broderie dress or a tiered midi skirt as with cropped trousers. Romantic, simple and good for walking all day.
details: Flexible stitched leather sole with rubber grip pads
Runs slim; size up half a size for wider feet
